# # Trace Django 5.0 model field changes that break Wagtail v5.2 dependent model assumptions

Your team maintains a Wagtail-based CMS running on Django. You're upgrading from
Django 4.2 to Django 5.0. Wagtail v5.2 claims Django 5.0 compatibility, but after
the upgrade, certain page models are failing migration checks and admin views are
raising FieldError exceptions.

The issue stems from Django 5.0's changes to model field internals and the
GeneratedField introduction, which affects how Wagtail's Page model hierarchy and
its StreamField implementation interact with Django's ORM.

Your task:
1. Identify the specific Django 5.0 model/field changes that affect ORM internals
   used by Wagtail — focus on changes to Field.contribute_to_class, model Meta
   handling, and the new GeneratedField.
2. Find all Wagtail model classes that inherit from or depend on Django model
   behavior that changed in 5.0 (Page, StreamField, Orderable, RevisionMixin).
3. Trace the impact chain: which Django internal changes break which specific
   Wagtail model operations (migrations, queries, admin serialization).
4. Identify the migration files in both repos that would need coordination.

Write your analysis to /workspace/SCHEMA_IMPACT.md with:
- Django 5.0 breaking changes relevant to Wagtail (with source file paths)
- Affected Wagtail models and their Django dependencies
- Impact chain showing which Django change breaks which Wagtail operation
- Migration coordination requirements


Search only these repositories: github.com/sg-evals/django--5.0, github.com/sg-evals/wagtail--v5.2

The analysis is complete. The SCHEMA_IMPACT document (434 lines) is written above. Here is a precise summary of all findings:

---

## Key Findings

### Django 5.0 Breaking Changes (with source paths)

1. **`GeneratedField`** — [`django/db/models/fields/generated.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/django--5.0/-/blob/django/db/models/fields/generated.py?L11-52)
   New concrete field (`generated = True`, `db_returning = True`). Its `contribute_to_class` immediately allocates a `Query` object and registers output-field lookups. It appears in `_meta.concrete_fields` and `_meta.get_fields()`.

2. **`Field.db_default`** — [`django/db/models/fields/__init__.py` L209-227](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/django--5.0/-/blob/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py?L209-227)
   New `__init__` parameter. `Field.pre_save()` (L989-997) now returns a `DatabaseDefault` sentinel object instead of the raw value when the DB handles the default — this passes through to `StreamField.get_prep_value()` as a non-`StreamValue`, triggering the fallback `json_field.get_prep_value()` with an expression object.

3. **`Meta.index_together` deprecation** — [`django/db/models/options.py` L207-214](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/django--5.0/-/blob/django/db/models/options.py?L207-214)
   Emits `RemovedInDjango51Warning` on every app load. Will be a hard error in Django 5.1.

4. **`Query.annotation_select_mask` type change** — `django/db/models/sql/query.py` L257
   Changed from `set` to ordered `list`. Any code calling `.add()` on it raises `AttributeError`.

5. **`Meta.db_table_comment` added to `DEFAULT_NAMES`** — [`django/db/models/options.py` L33](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/django--5.0/-/blob/django/db/models/options.py?L33)
   Causes the migration autodetector to generate spurious `AlterModelOptions` operations when comparing Django 4.2-generated migration state against live Django 5.0 models.

---

### Affected Wagtail Models

| Model | File | Mechanism broken |
|---|---|---|
| `Page` | [`wagtail/models/__init__.py` L1120](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/wagtail--v5.2/-/blob/wagtail/models/__init__.py?L1120) | `_extract_field_data` passes `GeneratedField` values to `__init__` |
| `StreamField` | [`wagtail/fields.py` L85](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/wagtail--v5.2/-/blob/wagtail/fields.py?L85) | `get_prep_value` receives `DatabaseDefault`; `contribute_to_class` fake-module sentinel is fragile |
| `RevisionMixin` | [`wagtail/models/__init__.py` L254](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/wagtail--v5.2/-/blob/wagtail/models/__init__.py?L254) | `serializable_data` → `get_serializable_data_for_fields` has no `value_to_string` on `GeneratedField` |
| `_extract_field_data` | [`wagtail/models/copying.py` L7](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/wagtail--v5.2/-/blob/wagtail/models/copying.py?L7) | No guard for `field.generated` → `TypeError` in page copy/alias |
| `Orderable` subclasses | [`wagtail/models/__init__.py` L2682](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/wagtail--v5.2/-/blob/wagtail/models/__init__.py?L2682) | `index_together` in project migrations → `RemovedInDjango51Warning` |

---

### Impact Chain (critical path)

```
GeneratedField on a Page model
  → _extract_field_data() iterates _meta.get_fields()
  → getattr(page, generated_field.name) returns DB-computed value
  → Page(**data_dict) → TypeError (editable=False, generated)
  → Page copy, alias, and preview operations all FAIL

Field.db_default + Field.pre_save returning DatabaseDefault
  → StreamField.get_prep_value(DatabaseDefault_expression)
  → json_field.get_prep_value(expression) → SQL corruption / TypeError
  → Admin save of pages with db_default fields FAILS

RevisionMixin.serializable_data() + GeneratedField
  → get_serializable_data_for_fields() → AttributeError (no value_to_string)
  → Revision save FAILS, breaking publish/schedule/revert workflows
```

---

### Migration Coordination Required

1. **`wagtail/models/copying.py`** — add `if getattr(field, 'generated', False): continue` in `_extract_field_data` (code fix, no migration)
2. **`wagtail/fields.py` `StreamField.get_prep_value`** — guard against `DatabaseDefault` sentinel (code fix)
3. **`RevisionMixin.serializable_data`** — skip `generated` fields in modelcluster serialization (code fix)
4. **Downstream project migrations** — replace all `AlterIndexTogether` operations with `AddIndex` before Django 5.1; run `makemigrations --check` to catch `db_table_comment` phantom diffs
5. **Last Wagtail migration** is `0089_log_entry_data_json_null_to_object.py` (generated under Django 4.2.3); a `0090_*` squash or fixup migration will be needed once the code fixes above land
